research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Queenly is researching a method and server for classifying apparel depicted in images and a system for improving the identification of clothing attributes in listings. The abstract describes a solution to the challenge of incomplete or inconsistent information in secondhand clothing markets by using reference shapes to classify images of apparel items. This work focuses on enhancing the accuracy and standardization of formalwear listings and image-based apparel classification.

overview_description.description:
Queenly is the dedicated marketplace and search engine for the formalwear industry. Queenly was one of the top companies that came out from the Y Combinator Winter 2021 batch, according to TechCrunch, and recently raised a Seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z.com). They have now captured the largest formal dress inventory in the US by surpassing that of Macy’s, Rent the Runway & Nordstrom, since launching less than 2 years ago. Queenly is tackling the highly underserved prom, pageant, quinceañera, and wedding industry (and more!). They cater to this massive community of dress enthusiasts for this high-priced & low-usage inventory, similar to how GOAT and StockX have built a platform for the sneaker and streetwear community. 

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in San Francisco, California.
